pigheatmap 把"按胎次 × 月份（或场区、品系……）汇总某项生产指标，再画成带数值标注的热图"
这件事封装成一个函数。本文用包内的模拟数据 `sow_demo` 演示主要用法。

```{r}
head(sow_demo)
```

# 汇总数据：summarise_heatmap_data()

`summarise_heatmap_data()` 按 X × Y（以及可选的分面变量）分组，计算每个格子的统计值
`stat_value` 和有效样本数 `count`。它是 `plot_performance_heatmap()` 的第一步，单独导出
方便拿到汇总表另作他用，比如导出到 Excel 或写进报告。

```{r function-summarise_heatmap_data, filename = "summarise"}
#' 按热图格子聚合数据
#'
#' @description
#' 按 `x_var` × `y_var`（以及可选的分面变量）分组，计算每个格子的统计值和样本数。
#' 这是 [plot_performance_heatmap()] 的数据准备步骤，单独导出是为了方便：
#'
#' * 拿到汇总表另作他用（导出 Excel、写报告等）；
#' * 在绘图前先检查聚合结果是否符合预期。
#'
#' @param data 原始数据框。
#' @param x_var,y_var X 轴、Y 轴映射的列名（字符串）。
#' @param fill_var 需要聚合的数值列名（字符串）。因子或字符型的数字会被自动转换。
#' @param facet_vars （可选）分面变量名，长度为 1 或 2。
#' @param summary_stat 聚合统计量：`"mean"`（默认）、`"median"`、`"sum"`、`"sd"`、
#'   `"min"`、`"max"`，或自定义函数，例如
#'   `function(x) quantile(x, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE)`。
#' @param min_count 单元格最少样本数，低于该值的格子会被剔除，默认为 1（不剔除）。
#'
#' @return 一个 tibble，包含分组列以及：
#'   * `stat_value`：该格子的统计值；
#'   * `count`：该格子的有效样本数（`fill_var` 非缺失的行数）。
#' @export
#' @examples
summarise_heatmap_data <- function(data,
                                   x_var,
                                   y_var,
                                   fill_var,
                                   facet_vars = NULL,
                                   summary_stat = c("mean", "median", "sum", "sd", "min", "max"),
                                   min_count = 1) {
  check_data_cols(data, x_var, y_var, fill_var, facet_vars)
  if (!is.numeric(min_count) || length(min_count) != 1 || is.na(min_count) || min_count < 1) {
    stop(.msg$min_count_bad, call. = FALSE)
  }
  stat <- resolve_stat(summary_stat)

  # 确保填充变量为数值型（处理因子或字符型数字）。
  # 用 suppressWarnings 屏蔽 R 自带的 "NAs introduced by coercion"，只保留下面这条更具体的提示。
  raw <- data[[fill_var]]
  values <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(raw)))
  n_coerced <- sum(is.na(values)) - sum(is.na(raw))
  if (n_coerced > 0) {
    warning(sprintf(.msg$coerce_na, fill_var, n_coerced), call. = FALSE)
  }
  data[[fill_var]] <- values

  group_cols <- c(x_var, y_var, facet_vars)
  stat_fun <- stat$fun

  out <- data[!is.na(data[[fill_var]]), , drop = FALSE]
  out <- dplyr::summarise(
    out,
    stat_value = stat_fun(.data[[fill_var]]),
    count = dplyr::n(),
    .by = dplyr::all_of(group_cols)
  )
  out <- out[out$count >= min_count, , drop = FALSE]

  # 部分统计量（如只有 1 个样本时的标准差）会得到 NA，剔除并提示
  na_stat <- is.na(out$stat_value)
  if (any(na_stat)) {
    warning(sprintf(.msg$stat_na, sum(na_stat)), call. = FALSE)
    out <- out[!na_stat, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  # 按分组列排序，保证输出稳定（.by 保留首次出现的顺序）
  out <- dplyr::arrange(out, dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(group_cols)))
  dplyr::as_tibble(out)
}
```

```{r examples-summarise_heatmap_data}
# 各场、各胎次的平均断奶数
summarise_heatmap_data(sow_demo, x_var = "farm", y_var = "parity", fill_var = "weaned")

# 用中位数，并剔除样本数少于 10 窝的格子
summarise_heatmap_data(
  sow_demo, "farm", "parity", "weaned",
  summary_stat = "median", min_count = 10
)
```

```{r function-resolve_stat, filename = "summarise"}
#' 将统计量名称解析为聚合函数
#'
#' @param summary_stat 字符串（"mean"/"median"/"sum"/"sd"/"min"/"max"）或自定义函数。
#' @return 列表：`fun` 为聚合函数，`name` 为统计量名称（自定义函数时为 `NULL`）。
#' @noRd
resolve_stat <- function(summary_stat) {
  if (is.function(summary_stat)) {
    return(list(fun = summary_stat, name = NULL))
  }
  name <- match.arg(summary_stat, names(.stat_default_labels))
  fun <- switch(name,
    mean   = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = function(x) stats::median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum    = function(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd     = function(x) stats::sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    min    = function(x) min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    max    = function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  list(fun = fun, name = name)
}

#' 校验输入数据框与列名
#' @noRd
check_data_cols <- function(data, x_var, y_var, fill_var, facet_vars) {
  if (!is.data.frame(data)) {
    stop(.msg$not_df, call. = FALSE)
  }
  missing_cols <- setdiff(c(x_var, y_var, fill_var, facet_vars), names(data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(sprintf(.msg$missing_cols, paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (!is.null(facet_vars) && !length(facet_vars) %in% c(1, 2)) {
    stop(sprintf(.msg$facet_len, length(facet_vars)), call. = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

```{r tests-summarise_heatmap_data, filename = "summarise"}
test_that("均值与计数正确", {
  out <- summarise_heatmap_data(make_sow_data(), "farm", "parity", "weaned")
  expect_named(out, c("farm", "parity", "stat_value", "count"))
  expect_equal(nrow(out), 6)
  a1 <- out[out$farm == "A" & out$parity == 1, ]
  expect_equal(a1$stat_value, mean(c(10, 9)))
  expect_equal(a1$count, 2L)
})

test_that("支持内置统计量与自定义函数", {
  d <- make_sow_data()
  expect_equal(
    summarise_heatmap_data(d, "farm", "parity", "weaned", summary_stat = "max")$stat_value[1],
    10
  )
  q90 <- function(x) stats::quantile(x, 0.9, names = FALSE)
  out <- summarise_heatmap_data(d, "farm", "parity", "weaned", summary_stat = q90)
  expect_equal(out$stat_value[1], q90(c(10, 9)))
  expect_error(summarise_heatmap_data(d, "farm", "parity", "weaned", summary_stat = "mode"))
})

test_that("min_count 过滤格子", {
  d <- make_sow_data()
  d <- rbind(d, data.frame(farm = "C", parity = 1, weaned = 8))
  out <- summarise_heatmap_data(d, "farm", "parity", "weaned", min_count = 2)
  expect_false("C" %in% out$farm)
  expect_error(summarise_heatmap_data(d, "farm", "parity", "weaned", min_count = 0), "min_count")
})

test_that("字符型数值被转换，无法转换的只给出一条提示", {
  d <- make_sow_data()
  d$weaned <- as.character(d$weaned)
  d$weaned[1] <- "abc"
  w <- character()
  out <- withCallingHandlers(
    summarise_heatmap_data(d, "farm", "parity", "weaned"),
    warning = function(cnd) {
      w <<- c(w, conditionMessage(cnd))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )
  expect_length(w, 1) # 不再出现 R 自带的 "NAs introduced by coercion"
  expect_match(w, "1")
  expect_equal(out$count[out$farm == "A" & out$parity == 1], 1L)
})

test_that("标准差为 NA 的格子被剔除并提示", {
  d <- data.frame(x = c("a", "a", "b"), y = 1, v = c(1, 2, 3))
  expect_warning(
    out <- summarise_heatmap_data(d, "x", "y", "v", summary_stat = "sd"),
    "NA"
  )
  expect_equal(out$x, "a")
})

test_that("输入校验", {
  d <- make_sow_data()
  expect_error(summarise_heatmap_data(list(), "farm", "parity", "weaned"), "data")
  expect_error(summarise_heatmap_data(d, "farm", "nope", "weaned"), "nope")
  expect_error(
    summarise_heatmap_data(d, "farm", "parity", "weaned", facet_vars = c("farm", "parity", "weaned")),
    "facet_vars"
  )
})

test_that("示例数据集 sow_demo 可以直接汇总", {
  out <- summarise_heatmap_data(sow_demo, "farm", "parity", "weaned")
  expect_equal(sum(out$count), nrow(sow_demo))
})
```

# 绘制热图：plot_performance_heatmap()

`plot_performance_heatmap()` 在汇总的基础上完成绘图：格子里用富文本标注统计值和样本数，
颜色映射有三种模式（`plot_type`）：

* `"general"`（默认）：红-白-绿双向渐变，中间值默认为统计值的均值；
* `"parity"`：内置的胎次分段色阶，按**胎次数值**着色（3~5 胎绿色、两端灰色），
  用于 `fill_var` 本身就是胎次的场景，例如看各场、各月的平均胎次（胎龄结构），
  详见 `vignette("segmented-scales")`；
* `"segmented"`：自定义分段色阶，适合背膘厚、首配日龄等有经验最优区间的性状。

```{r function-plot_performance_heatmap, filename = "heatmap"}
#' 绘制性能热图 (Performance Heatmap)
#'
#' @description
#' 通用热图绘制函数：自动聚合数据（均值/中位数/总和/标准差/...）、HTML 富文本标签、
#' 动态分面、按样本量调节透明度，以及针对任意性状的自定义分段色阶（胎次、背膘厚、
#' 首配日龄等有经验区间划分的性状都适用）。
#'
#' 数据聚合由 [summarise_heatmap_data()] 完成；如需拿到汇总表，可以直接调用该函数，
#' 或从返回的图对象中取 `p$data`。
#'
#' @inheritParams summarise_heatmap_data
#' @param plot_type 颜色映射方式：
#'   * `"general"`（默认）：红-白-绿双向渐变，中间值默认为统计值的均值；
#'   * `"parity"`：内置胎次分段色阶（灰-黄-绿-黄绿-橙-红-灰），见 [default_parity_stops()]，
#'     可用 `color_stops` 覆盖。色阶断点是**胎次数值**（0~10），因此适用于 `fill_var`
#'     本身是胎次的场景，例如展示各场、各月的平均胎次；对产仔数等其他指标请用
#'     `"general"` 或 `"segmented"`；
#'   * `"segmented"`：通用分段色阶，必须通过 `color_stops` 提供断点与颜色。
#' @param x_lab,y_lab,title,subtitle （可选）X 轴标题、Y 轴标题、总标题、副标题。
#' @param fill_lab （可选）图例标题。不填则根据 `summary_stat` 自动生成（如"平均值"）。
#' @param show_count 是否在格子中显示样本数，默认为 `TRUE`。
#' @param count_label 样本数的名称，用于底部说明文字，默认为"窝数"。
#' @param show_caption 是否显示底部说明文字，默认为 `TRUE`。
#' @param text_layout 格子内文字布局：`"v"`（默认，数值在上、样本数在下）或 `"h"`（同一行）。
#' @param label_digits 统计值保留的小数位数，默认为 1。显示时会补齐小数位（如 `2.0`）。
#' @param label_size 格子文字大小，默认为 3.5。
#' @param label_color 格子文字颜色。默认 `"auto"`：根据格子填充色的亮度自动选择黑色
#'   或白色，保证深色格子上的文字也清晰可读；也可以传入固定颜色，如 `"black"`。
#' @param alpha_by_count 是否按样本量调节格子透明度（样本越少越透明），用来提示
#'   "该格子的统计结果不够可靠"。默认为 `FALSE`。
#' @param alpha_range 长度为 2 的透明度范围（最小, 最大），默认为 `c(0.35, 1)`。
#' @param alpha_count_cap （可选）样本量达到该值即视为充分，透明度封顶。默认取数据中
#'   样本量的最大值。
#' @param low_color,mid_color,high_color `"general"` 模式下渐变的低/中/高端颜色。
#' @param midpoint （可选）`"general"` 模式下渐变的中间值，默认取统计值的均值。
#' @param color_stops （可选）分段色阶断点，含 `value`、`color` 两列，按 `value` 升序，
#'   允许重复 `value` 制造硬分界。详见 [build_segment_scale()]。
#' @param color_limits （可选）分段色阶的取值范围，默认为 `range(color_stops$value)`。
#' @param color_oob 分段色阶越界值处理函数，默认为 [scales::squish()]。
#' @param x_axis_type,y_axis_type 坐标轴刻度策略：`"auto"`（默认，变量名匹配
#'   `auto_detect_pattern` 时按胎次处理）、`"parity"`（强制从 1 开始的整数刻度，
#'   要求该列为数值型）、`"continuous"`（ggplot2 默认刻度）。
#' @param auto_detect_pattern `"auto"` 模式下识别"胎次类"变量名的正则表达式，默认为"胎次"。
#' @param facet_scales 分面的 `scales` 策略，传给 [ggplot2::facet_grid()]，默认为 `"free"`。
#' @param facet_space 分面的 `space` 策略，默认为 `"free"`（面板大小随类别数变化，
#'   各格子物理大小基本一致）。只在对应方向的 `facet_scales` 为 free 时生效。
#'   如果某些分面类别很少、面板过窄导致文字被遮挡，可改成 `"fixed"`。
#' @param clip_off 是否关闭坐标系裁剪，默认为 `TRUE`，避免窄分面中贴近边缘的标签被切掉。
#'   函数内部会添加 `coord_cartesian(clip = "off")`，因此之后再叠加其他
#'   `coord_*()` 时 ggplot2 会提示坐标系被替换，这是正常现象。
#' @param theme_args 传给 [get_common_theme()] 的参数列表，用于调整字号、坐标轴角度、
#'   分面间距等，例如 `list(x_axis_angle = 0, strip_text_size = 16)`。
#'
#' @return 一个 ggplot 对象。可以继续用 `+` 叠加图层或主题。
#' @export
#' @examples
plot_performance_heatmap <- function(data,
                                     x_var,
                                     y_var,
                                     fill_var,
                                     facet_vars = NULL,
                                     plot_type = c("general", "parity", "segmented"),
                                     summary_stat = c("mean", "median", "sum", "sd", "min", "max"),
                                     min_count = 1,
                                     x_lab = NULL,
                                     y_lab = NULL,
                                     title = NULL,
                                     subtitle = NULL,
                                     fill_lab = NULL,
                                     show_count = TRUE,
                                     count_label = "\u7a9d\u6570", # 窝数
                                     show_caption = TRUE,
                                     text_layout = c("v", "h"),
                                     label_digits = 1,
                                     label_size = 3.5,
                                     label_color = "auto",
                                     alpha_by_count = FALSE,
                                     alpha_range = c(0.35, 1),
                                     alpha_count_cap = NULL,
                                     low_color = "#D73027",
                                     mid_color = "#F7F7F7",
                                     high_color = "#1A9850",
                                     midpoint = NULL,
                                     color_stops = NULL,
                                     color_limits = NULL,
                                     color_oob = scales::squish,
                                     x_axis_type = c("auto", "parity", "continuous"),
                                     y_axis_type = c("auto", "parity", "continuous"),
                                     auto_detect_pattern = "\u80ce\u6b21", # 胎次
                                     facet_scales = c("free", "free_x", "free_y", "fixed"),
                                     facet_space = c("free", "free_x", "free_y", "fixed"),
                                     clip_off = TRUE,
                                     theme_args = list()) {

  # --- 1. 参数校验 ---
  plot_type <- match.arg(plot_type)
  text_layout <- match.arg(text_layout)
  x_axis_type <- match.arg(x_axis_type)
  y_axis_type <- match.arg(y_axis_type)
  facet_scales <- match.arg(facet_scales)
  facet_space <- match.arg(facet_space)
  check_theme_args(theme_args)
  check_alpha_range(alpha_range)

  if (plot_type == "segmented" && is.null(color_stops)) {
    stop(.msg$need_stops, call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (!is.null(color_stops)) check_stops(color_stops)

  # 统计量只解析一次，聚合函数和图例标题都基于同一结果
  stat <- resolve_stat(summary_stat)
  legend_label <- fill_lab %||%
    (if (is.null(stat$name)) .msg$generic_stat else .stat_default_labels[[stat$name]])

  # --- 2. 数据聚合 ---
  plot_data <- summarise_heatmap_data(
    data, x_var, y_var, fill_var,
    facet_vars = facet_vars,
    summary_stat = if (is.null(stat$name)) stat$fun else stat$name,
    min_count = min_count
  )
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    stop(.msg$no_data, call. = FALSE)
  }

  # --- 3. 单元格标签（HTML） ---
  # formatC 保证小数位数一致：2 显示为 "2.0"，而不是 round() 之后的 "2"
  value_txt <- formatC(plot_data$stat_value, format = "f", digits = label_digits)
  plot_data$label_text <- if (!show_count) {
    paste0("<b>", value_txt, "</b>")
  } else if (text_layout == "h") {
    paste0("<b>", value_txt, "</b> (", plot_data$count, ")")
  } else {
    paste0("<b>", value_txt, "</b><br>(", plot_data$count, ")")
  }

  # --- 4. 透明度（按样本量体现可信度） ---
  plot_data$.alpha <- if (alpha_by_count) {
    count_to_alpha(plot_data$count, min_count, alpha_count_cap, alpha_range)
  } else {
    1
  }

  # --- 5. 填充色阶 ---
  fill_scale <- if (plot_type == "general") {
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = low_color, mid = mid_color, high = high_color,
      midpoint = midpoint %||% mean(plot_data$stat_value),
      name = legend_label
    )
  } else {
    stops <- color_stops %||% default_parity_stops()
    build_segment_scale(
      stops,
      limits = color_limits %||% range(stops$value),
      oob = color_oob,
      name = legend_label
    )
  }

  # --- 6. 文字颜色 ---
  plot_data$.label_color <- if (identical(label_color, "auto")) {
    auto_text_color(fill_scale, plot_data$stat_value, plot_data$.alpha)
  } else {
    label_color
  }

  # --- 7. 绘图 ---
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_data,
    ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[x_var]], y = .data[[y_var]], fill = .data$stat_value)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_tile(ggplot2::aes(alpha = .data$.alpha), color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    ggplot2::scale_alpha_identity(guide = "none") +
    ggtext::geom_richtext(
      ggplot2::aes(label = .data$label_text, colour = .data$.label_color),
      label.color = NA,
      fill = NA,
      size = label_size,
      lineheight = if (text_layout == "h") 1.0 else 0.8
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_identity(guide = "none") +
    fill_scale

  # --- 8. 坐标轴刻度 ---
  p <- p + parity_axis_scale("x", x_axis_type, x_var, plot_data, auto_detect_pattern)
  p <- p + parity_axis_scale("y", y_axis_type, y_var, plot_data, auto_detect_pattern)

  # --- 9. 分面 ---
  if (!is.null(facet_vars)) {
    check_facet_space(facet_scales, facet_space)
    p <- p + if (length(facet_vars) == 1) {
      ggplot2::facet_grid(
        cols = ggplot2::vars(.data[[facet_vars[1]]]),
        scales = facet_scales, space = facet_space
      )
    } else {
      ggplot2::facet_grid(
        rows = ggplot2::vars(.data[[facet_vars[1]]]),
        cols = ggplot2::vars(.data[[facet_vars[2]]]),
        scales = facet_scales, space = facet_space
      )
    }
  }

  if (clip_off) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
  }

  # --- 10. 标题与主题 ---
  caption_text <- NULL
  if (show_caption) {
    caption_text <- paste0(.msg$caption_prefix, "<b>", legend_label, "</b>")
    if (show_count) caption_text <- paste0(caption_text, " (", count_label, ")")
  }

  p +
    ggplot2::labs(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, title = title, subtitle = subtitle, caption = caption_text) +
    do.call(get_common_theme, theme_args)
}
```

最简单的用法只需要指定数据、X、Y 和要汇总的指标：

```{r examples-plot_performance_heatmap}
# 通用红-白-绿渐变：各场、各胎次的平均断奶数
plot_performance_heatmap(
  sow_demo,
  x_var = "farm", y_var = "parity", fill_var = "weaned",
  y_axis_type = "parity",
  x_lab = "Farm", y_lab = "Parity"
)

# 按场分面 + 按样本量调节透明度（高胎次窝数少，格子更透明）
plot_performance_heatmap(
  sow_demo,
  x_var = "month", y_var = "parity", fill_var = "born_alive",
  facet_vars = "farm",
  y_axis_type = "parity",
  alpha_by_count = TRUE,
  theme_args = list(x_axis_angle = -45, strip_text_size = 14)
)

# 胎次分段配色：各场、各月的平均胎次（3~5 胎为绿色，偏低为黄色，偏高为橙红色）
plot_performance_heatmap(
  sow_demo,
  x_var = "month", y_var = "farm", fill_var = "parity",
  plot_type = "parity",
  fill_lab = "Mean parity",
  theme_args = list(x_axis_angle = 0)
)
```

```{r function-heatmap_helpers, filename = "heatmap"}
#' 样本量 -> 透明度
#' @noRd
count_to_alpha <- function(count, min_count, cap, alpha_range) {
  cap <- cap %||% max(count)
  if (cap <= min_count) cap <- min_count + 1 # 避免 from 区间长度为 0
  scales::rescale(pmin(count, cap), to = alpha_range, from = c(min_count, cap))
}

#' 根据填充色亮度选择黑/白文字
#'
#' 先用色阶把统计值映射成颜色，再按透明度与白色背景混合，得到格子实际呈现的颜色，
#' 最后用 WCAG 相对亮度判断：亮色背景用黑字，暗色背景用白字。
#' @noRd
auto_text_color <- function(fill_scale, values, alpha = 1, threshold = 0.4) {
  sc <- fill_scale$clone()
  sc$train(values)
  cols <- sc$map(values)
  rgb <- grDevices::col2rgb(cols, alpha = FALSE) / 255
  alpha <- rep_len(alpha, length(values))
  rgb <- sweep(rgb, 2, alpha, `*`) + sweep(matrix(1, 3, length(values)), 2, 1 - alpha, `*`)
  lin <- ifelse(rgb <= 0.03928, rgb / 12.92, ((rgb + 0.055) / 1.055)^2.4)
  lum <- 0.2126 * lin[1, ] + 0.7152 * lin[2, ] + 0.0722 * lin[3, ]
  ifelse(is.na(lum) | lum > threshold, "black", "white")
}

#' 从 1 开始、覆盖数据范围的整数刻度
#'
#' 直接根据数据中实际出现的取值生成，而不是用 breaks 函数：坐标系传给 breaks
#' 函数的是扩展后的范围（例如 1~10 胎会变成 0~11），会多出空刻度。
#' 分面 scales = "free" 时，超出单个面板范围的刻度会被 ggplot2 自动丢弃。
#' @noRd
integer_breaks_from_one <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(ggplot2::waiver())
  start_val <- max(1, floor(min(x)))
  end_val <- ceiling(max(x))
  if (start_val > end_val) return(ggplot2::waiver())
  seq(start_val, end_val, by = 1)
}

#' 胎次类坐标轴：返回整数刻度的 scale，或 NULL（不修改）
#' @noRd
parity_axis_scale <- function(axis, axis_type, var, plot_data, pattern) {
  if (axis_type == "auto") {
    axis_type <- if (grepl(pattern, var)) "parity" else "continuous"
  }
  if (axis_type != "parity") return(NULL)
  if (!is.numeric(plot_data[[var]])) {
    warning(sprintf(.msg$axis_not_numeric, var), call. = FALSE)
    return(NULL)
  }
  breaks <- integer_breaks_from_one(plot_data[[var]])
  if (axis == "x") {
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = breaks)
  } else {
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = breaks)
  }
}

#' @noRd
check_theme_args <- function(theme_args) {
  if (!is.list(theme_args) || (length(theme_args) > 0 && is.null(names(theme_args))) ||
      any(names(theme_args) == "")) {
    stop(.msg$theme_args_bad, call. = FALSE)
  }
  unknown <- setdiff(names(theme_args), names(formals(get_common_theme)))
  if (length(unknown) > 0) {
    stop(sprintf(.msg$theme_args_unknown, paste(unknown, collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

#' @noRd
check_alpha_range <- function(alpha_range) {
  if (!is.numeric(alpha_range) || length(alpha_range) != 2 || anyNA(alpha_range) ||
      any(alpha_range < 0 | alpha_range > 1) || alpha_range[1] > alpha_range[2]) {
    stop(.msg$alpha_range_bad, call. = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

#' facet space 只在对应方向 scales 为 free 时生效，否则给出提示
#' @noRd
check_facet_space <- function(facet_scales, facet_space) {
  free_x <- facet_scales %in% c("free", "free_x")
  free_y <- facet_scales %in% c("free", "free_y")
  space_x <- facet_space %in% c("free", "free_x")
  space_y <- facet_space %in% c("free", "free_y")
  if ((space_x && !free_x) || (space_y && !free_y)) {
    warning(sprintf(.msg$space_ignored, facet_space), call. = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

## 中文列名与胎次自动识别

实际数据里的列名通常是中文。`y_axis_type` 默认为 `"auto"`：只要列名匹配
`auto_detect_pattern`（默认为"胎次"），就会自动使用从 1 开始的整数刻度，不必手动指定。

```{r}
sow_cn <- data.frame(
  "年月" = sow_demo$month,
  "场区" = sow_demo$farm,
  "胎次" = sow_demo$parity,
  "断奶数" = sow_demo$weaned,
  check.names = FALSE
)

plot_performance_heatmap(
  sow_cn,
  x_var = "年月", y_var = "胎次", fill_var = "断奶数",
  title = "各月份分胎次平均断奶数"
)
```

用胎次色阶看各场的胎龄结构：

```{r, fig.height = 4.5}
plot_performance_heatmap(
  sow_cn,
  x_var = "年月", y_var = "场区", fill_var = "胎次",
  plot_type = "parity",
  fill_lab = "平均胎次",
  title = "各场月度平均胎次",
  theme_args = list(x_axis_angle = 0)
)
```

## 统计量、样本量阈值与格子标签

```{r, fig.height = 4.5}
plot_performance_heatmap(
  sow_demo,
  x_var = "month", y_var = "farm", fill_var = "backfat",
  summary_stat = "median",   # 也可以是 "sd"、"max" 或自定义函数
  min_count = 30,            # 少于 30 窝的格子不显示
  text_layout = "h",         # 数值和样本数放在同一行
  label_digits = 2,
  count_label = "窝",
  fill_lab = "背膘厚中位数 (mm)",
  theme_args = list(x_axis_angle = 0)
)
```

## 继续用 ggplot2 修改

返回值是普通的 ggplot 对象，可以继续叠加图层或主题；汇总数据保存在 `p$data` 中。

```{r, fig.height = 4.5}
p <- plot_performance_heatmap(
  sow_demo, "month", "farm", "weaned",
  theme_args = list(x_axis_angle = 0)
)
p + ggplot2::labs(subtitle = "数据来源：sow_demo 模拟数据")
head(p$data)
```

## 导出图片

导出含中文的图片前，先调用一次 `enable_cn_font()`，并让 `dpi` 与 `ggsave()` 一致，
详见 `vignette("theme-and-fonts")`。

```{r, eval = FALSE}
enable_cn_font(dpi = 300)
ggplot2::ggsave("heatmap.png", p, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r tests-plot_performance_heatmap, filename = "heatmap"}
build <- function(p) ggplot2::ggplot_build(p)

test_that("返回可正常构建的 ggplot 对象", {
  p <- plot_performance_heatmap(make_sow_data(), "farm", "parity", "weaned")
  expect_s3_class(p, "ggplot")
  expect_silent(b <- build(p))
  expect_equal(nrow(b$data[[1]]), 6)
})

test_that("标签小数位补齐，布局 v/h 与 show_count 生效", {
  d <- data.frame(x = c("a", "b"), y = 1, v = c(2, 3.25))
  p <- plot_performance_heatmap(d, "x", "y", "v", label_digits = 1)
  expect_equal(p$data$label_text, c("<b>2.0</b><br>(1)", "<b>3.2</b><br>(1)"))

  p <- plot_performance_heatmap(d, "x", "y", "v", text_layout = "h")
  expect_equal(p$data$label_text[1], "<b>2.0</b> (1)")

  p <- plot_performance_heatmap(d, "x", "y", "v", show_count = FALSE)
  expect_equal(p$data$label_text[1], "<b>2.0</b>")
})

test_that("segmented 模式必须提供 color_stops", {
  expect_error(
    plot_performance_heatmap(make_sow_data(), "farm", "parity", "weaned", plot_type = "segmented"),
    "color_stops"
  )
  stops <- data.frame(value = c(8, 11, 14), color = c("red", "green", "red"))
  p <- plot_performance_heatmap(
    make_sow_data(), "farm", "parity", "weaned",
    plot_type = "segmented", color_stops = stops
  )
  expect_silent(build(p))
})

test_that("parity 模式使用默认胎次色阶", {
  d <- data.frame(x = "a", parity = c(1, 5, 8, 10), v = c(1, 5, 8, 10))
  p <- plot_performance_heatmap(d, "x", "parity", "v", plot_type = "parity")
  fills <- toupper(substr(build(p)$data[[1]]$fill, 1, 7))
  expect_equal(fills, c(hex("grey70"), hex("#1A9850"), hex("#D73027"), hex("grey70")))
})

test_that("分面支持非规范列名（含空格、数字开头）", {
  d <- make_sow_data()
  d$`farm name` <- d$farm
  d$`2nd` <- rep(c("p", "q"), 6)
  p <- plot_performance_heatmap(d, "farm", "parity", "weaned", facet_vars = "farm name")
  expect_silent(build(p))
  p <- plot_performance_heatmap(d, "farm", "parity", "weaned", facet_vars = c("farm name", "2nd"))
  b <- build(p)
  expect_equal(length(unique(b$layout$layout$PANEL)), 4)
})

test_that("theme_args 透传到 get_common_theme，未知参数报错", {
  p <- plot_performance_heatmap(
    make_sow_data(), "farm", "parity", "weaned",
    theme_args = list(strip_text_size = 22, x_axis_angle = 0)
  )
  expect_equal(p$theme$strip.text$size, 22)
  expect_equal(p$theme$axis.text.x$angle, 0)
  expect_error(
    plot_performance_heatmap(make_sow_data(), "farm", "parity", "weaned",
                             theme_args = list(foo = 1)),
    "foo"
  )
  expect_error(
    plot_performance_heatmap(make_sow_data(), "farm", "parity", "weaned",
                             theme_args = list(1)),
    "theme_args"
  )
})

test_that("透明度按样本量变化，范围受 alpha_range 控制", {
  d <- data.frame(x = c(rep("a", 10), "b"), y = 1, v = 1:11)
  p <- plot_performance_heatmap(d, "x", "y", "v", alpha_by_count = TRUE, alpha_range = c(0.2, 0.9))
  expect_equal(range(p$data$.alpha), c(0.2, 0.9))
  expect_error(plot_performance_heatmap(d, "x", "y", "v", alpha_range = c(0.9, 0.2)), "alpha_range")
})

test_that("label_color = 'auto' 深色格子用白字、浅色格子用黑字", {
  d <- data.frame(x = c("a", "b", "c"), y = 1, v = c(0, 50, 100))
  p <- plot_performance_heatmap(d, "x", "y", "v", midpoint = 50)
  expect_equal(p$data$.label_color, c("white", "black", "white"))
  p <- plot_performance_heatmap(d, "x", "y", "v", label_color = "navy")
  expect_true(all(p$data$.label_color == "navy"))
})

test_that("说明文字使用 count_label，可以关闭", {
  p <- plot_performance_heatmap(make_sow_data(), "farm", "parity", "weaned", count_label = "n")
  expect_match(p$labels$caption, "(n)", fixed = TRUE)
  p <- plot_performance_heatmap(make_sow_data(), "farm", "parity", "weaned", show_caption = FALSE)
  expect_null(p$labels$caption)
})

test_that("胎次轴：使用整数刻度且不出现空刻度，非数值型给出提示", {
  d <- make_sow_data()
  p <- plot_performance_heatmap(d, "farm", "parity", "weaned", y_axis_type = "parity")
  brks <- build(p)$layout$panel_params[[1]]$y$breaks
  expect_equal(brks[!is.na(brks)], 1:3)

  d10 <- data.frame(x = "a", parity = 1:10, v = 1:10)
  p10 <- plot_performance_heatmap(d10, "x", "parity", "v", y_axis_type = "parity")
  brks <- build(p10)$layout$panel_params[[1]]$y$breaks
  expect_equal(brks[!is.na(brks)], 1:10)

  d$parity <- as.character(d$parity)
  expect_warning(
    plot_performance_heatmap(d, "farm", "parity", "weaned", y_axis_type = "parity"),
    "parity"
  )
})

test_that("中文列名“胎次”自动识别为整数刻度", {
  d <- make_sow_data()
  names(d)[names(d) == "parity"] <- "胎次"
  p <- plot_performance_heatmap(d, "farm", "胎次", "weaned")
  brks <- build(p)$layout$panel_params[[1]]$y$breaks
  expect_equal(brks[!is.na(brks)], 1:3)
})

test_that("facet_space 不生效时给出提示", {
  expect_warning(
    plot_performance_heatmap(make_sow_data(), "farm", "parity", "weaned",
                             facet_vars = "farm", facet_scales = "fixed"),
    "facet_space"
  )
})
```
